entities.summary: Oleg Borisovich Rakhmanin was a Soviet Russian politician and diplomat. Doctor of Sciences in Historical Sciences (1975), and professor (1977). Member of the Russian Academy of Natural Sciences, Russian Union of Journalists. Laureate of the USSR State Prize.
